title: Pluggable AST extractor and staged validator for routing DSL
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Refactor the routing policy ingestion path to introduce a small, fast AST extractor and a pluggable staged validation pipeline. Current monolithic schema checks are slow (esp. for bulk uploads and CI), make it hard to reason about incremental changes, and tightly couple region/tier/fallback rules to the canonical schema implementation. This work splits responsibilities into: 1) a lightweight parser that produces a typed, minimal AST suitable for runtime route resolution; 2) a staged validator pipeline (syntax -> semantic constraints -> policy-specific checks) where each stage is independently testable and can be extended via plugins; 3) compatibility adapters that emit migration warnings rather than hard errors for deprecated constructs. Goals: reduce validation latency for small edits by 5x, make server-side validation library embeddable in the Console and the Private control plane, and provide clear migration notices to customers during rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce AST extractor module with a stable public API and unit tests covering parsing of region selectors, tier specifiers, and fallback variants.
Implement staged validator with three stages and ability to register additional checks via plugin interface.
Benchmark: validation latency for a representative 200-line policy decreases from ~180ms to <35ms on CI worker.
Backward compatibility shim: deprecated routing constructs produce warnings (non-failing) in server mode and an opt-in strict mode for enforcement.
Add integration tests for Console policy editor to surface staged validation messages and suggested auto-fixes for common issues.
Deployment plan documented with canary rollout and telemetry keys for validation errors and warnings.
Security review completed for the plugin surface and sandboxing of third-party validators.
notes: Implementation will live in services/policy-ingest. Core parser will be implemented in Rust for performance; expose a thin C FFI and a Node wrapper used by Console.
Plugin interface targets Go and Rust validators; initial plugins: region-affinity-check, tier-quota-guard, fallback-compat-adaptor.
Telemetry: emit validation.stage.(syntax|semantic|policy).(ok|warn|err) with policy_id and actor metadata. Include histogram of validation latency.
Migration: provide a CLI flag `--strict-validate` for early adopters and a Console toggle for org admins. Default for Hosted remains the warning mode for 2 release cycles.
Performance targets to measure on CI worker types linux-x86-2cpu-8gb; add synthetic fuzz harness in tests/ to run 1k random policy permutations nightly.
Trade-offs: Rust parser introduces build complexity for Private customers; we will provide prebuilt binaries for major platforms and a pure-Go fallback (slower) during transition.
